Note that the report uses inner joins, so customers with no non-cancelled orders are not listed; to list them with 0, use LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status <> 'cancelled' LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id and wrap the sum in COALESCE(..., 0).
